text:
maya: quick design review — re: revoke flow modal for API creds. posted updated mock in figma and two copy options. want a11y + focus order check and an undo affordance decision.

maya: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/revoke-flow (see modal v3)

maya: Current behaviors: primary = Revoke (danger), secondary = Cancel. After revoke we show toast 'Key revoked' + an Undo link for 10s. Audit log entry created.

sam: looks cleaner, but worried about discoverability of Undo. users might not notice a small toast. can we add an inline row-level undo? or move Undo into the modal confirmation step? :thinking_face:

jin: @sam inline undo is doable but complicates list state. we could gray-out the row and show 'revoked — undo' in place; would need optimistic update + background API call.

lee: accessibility: if we gray-out then DOM changes must preserve focus. keyboard users might miss the toast. recommended: after modal confirms, move focus to top of table and announce region with polite aria-live: 'API key "app-server" revoked. Undo available.'

maya: good call @lee. can we try: keep toast + aria-live announcement + make toast keyboard-focusable (role=alertdialog?) so tab can reach Undo?

jin: making toast focusable is ok, but ensure it doesn't trap focus. Implementation idea: set tabindex=0 on toast, focus() it programmatically, and after 10s, remove. If user tabs out it should not return focus.

raj: backend: we already store pre-revoke snapshot, undo does a re-enable API key operation within 10s window. audit log flagged as 'temporary-revoke' so undo is safe. need idempotent semantics if undo arrives late.

sam: copy nit — current modal copy reads: "Are you sure you want to revoke this key? This will stop any apps using it." feels blunt. propose: Option A: softer, explicit include repercussions.

sam: Option A copy:
```
Revoke API key "app-server"?
Revoking this key immediately stops apps and services that use it. You can restore it within 10 seconds using the Undo action that appears afterward. For permanent removal, go to Manage Keys.
```

sam: Option B (short):
```
Revoke "app-server"?
This disables the key right away. An Undo link will appear for 10s if you change your mind.
```

lee: prefer option B for screen readers — shorter sentences, less cognitive load. ensure modal has role=dialog with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. Also include visually-hidden text: 'undo available for 10 seconds'.

maya: UX question: should Undo be in the toast only, or also show an ephemeral inline chip in the row? pros: inline chip draws attention; cons: more UI complexity. vote?

raj: leaning toward toast + inline visual state (row dim + status tag 'revoked') so users scanning the list see change. keep undo action centralized in toast to avoid multiple undo handlers.

jin: implementation checklist from frontend:
- modal ARIA labels
- focus move to toast after revoke
- toast tabindex + role=alertdialog? or role=status? need input from a11y.
- optimistic UI: mark row as revoked, show status tag
- undo API endpoint with idempotency
- unit tests for focus behavior

lee: role=status for polite announcements, role=alert for assertive. For keyboard-focusable Undo, use a focusable element with aria-live region separate. avoid alertdialog unless it's actually a modal. I'd implement: aria-live='polite' region + focusable toast button for Undo.

maya: sounds good. final copy decision: go with Sam Option B with tiny tweak to remove 10s mention in body but keep it in visually-hidden announcement? thoughts?

sam: i'd keep the 10s visible — users should know timeframe. maybe: add parentheses: 'Undo available for 10s.' short.

maya: ok final copy (modal):
```
Revoke "app-server"?
This disables the key right away. Undo available for 10s.
```

maya: post-revoke toast copy:
```
API key "app-server" revoked. Undo
```

lee: approve with ARIA tweaks: add visually-hidden 'Undo available for 10 seconds' sentence for screen readers and ensure focus lands on toast.

jin: I'll prototype behaviors today. @ops-bot can you kick off a design review checklist job when I push the branch?

ops-bot: queued job #492: design-review-checks for branch feature/revoke-undo — results in ~15m.

maya: thanks all. follow-up: jin will post PR with demo GIF and accessibility notes, lee will review a11y, sam will sanity-check copy in context.

sam: +1

lee: +1

raj: +1

jin: will post later today with PR link and GIF :rocket:
